title: Software Engineer
description: Build reliable, scalable software services using Python, Java, or TypeScript. Core focus on Data Structures, Algorithms, REST API design, Git, SQL databases, Docker, CI/CD, and foundational System Design principles. Strong problem-solving, unit testing, and clean code practices.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy Machine Learning models in Python using PyTorch and scikit-learn. Work on NLP pipelines, Pandas data prep, Docker deployment on AWS, and REST API serving with FastAPI. Git and SQL required.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Develop web apps using JavaScript, React, Node.js and Express with MongoDB or SQL databases. Strong HTML and CSS, REST API design, Git workflow and Agile teamwork.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze business data with SQL, Python, Pandas and Statistics. Build Data Visualization dashboards in Tableau or Power BI. Strong Communication needed.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Design Microservices in Python or Java with Django or Flask. Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS. Strong System Design, Data Structures and CI/CD.

title: NLP Research Intern
description: Research NLP and Deep Learning for Indian languages using Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow and Pandas. Knowledge of Algorithms, Statistics and Git is a plus.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Craft responsive interfaces with React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and Tailwind. Figma handoff, UI/UX sense, Testing and Git.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate infrastructure with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and Linux. Build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Python scripting and Git.

title: Data Scientist
description: Apply Machine Learning, Statistics and Data Analysis using Python, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy and SQL. Present insights with Data Visualization. Spark experience is a plus.
